snippet.title: Lia: Hacking Destiny ⚡ | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Lia: Hacking Destiny has launched on ALL platforms! ⚡

👉 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3740360/Lia_Hacking_Destiny/
👉 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10016773/
👉 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/lia-hacking-destiny-switch/
👉 Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-SG/games/store/lia-hacking-destiny/9P13BZGB5QH0
👉 Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.orube.liahd&hl
👉 iOS https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lia-hacking-destiny/id6754249486

⸻

Lia: Hacking Destiny is a fast-paced 2D action roguelike set on a post-apocalyptic Earth controlled by MegaCorp: an Artificial Intelligence that took over the world, destroyed nature, enslaved innocent kittens, and still floods everything with SPAM! Truly evil behavior 🫨

It’s up to you to infiltrate MegaCorp’s massive facilities, rescue the cats, bypass the extremely strict CAPTCHA system, resist the SPAM, and battle the most… unique bosses 😶 from a security robot who thinks he’s cool because he rides a segway, to an evil Chat GPT that insults you in a polite and informative tone! 🤖

Switch between a colossal arsenal of devastating weapons! Pair a sniper with a katana for surgical precision… or embrace pure chaos with a bazooka. Unlock dozens of power-ups, craft insane builds, and combine endless possibilities until every robot turns into crushed scrap metal! 👊

Humanity needs you. Fight, hack, and reignite hope. ⚡

⸻

👉 Play Lia: Hacking Destiny: https://linktr.ee/liahackingdestiny
👉 Discover our other games: https://linktr.ee/orubegames
👉 Follow us on social media: https://linktr.ee/orubegames

⸻
